Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Great Sacrifice
Cards.Text: Battle: Destroy your performing unbowed Personality and target an enemy unit with total Force equal to or lower than your performer's Force, plus Personal Honor, plus one if he is defending: Destroy the enemy unit.

Cards.Name: On the Hunt
Cards.Text:
Battle: Choose your performing Samurai: Attach an attachment in your hand to him, paying all costs but paying 4 less Gold.
Open: Choose your performing Samurai with an attachment: Straighten his unit.

Cards.Name: Tireless Efforts
Cards.Text:
Battle: Choose your performing Personality: Straighten him.
Battle/Open: Choose your performing Personality: Negate all current and new Force penalties on him.

Cards.Name: Costly Opportunity
Cards.Text: Battle: Destroy your target performing unbowed Samurai to target an enemy card without attachments. Abilities on other cards now in its unit may not be used. Destroy the targeted card.

Cards.Name: Silent Terror
Cards.Text: Battle: Choose your performing unbowed Ninja Personality and target an enemy card: Bow it. You may discard a card in the current battlefield's province.

Cards.Name: Goju Plot
Cards.Text: Battle: Destroy your performing Shadowlands Ninja Personality and target a Ninja Personality in your discard pile: Bring him into play at the current battlefield, paying all costs but reducing his Gold cost to enter play by the performer's Gold Cost. Lose 2 Honor. You may take an additional Battle action.
